text: THE HOME PAGE'S THREE PUBLISHED FIGURES ARE THE BRAND BAR THE DESIGN DRAWS. They were a white card with the marks above the figures and the dashboard link floating beside it; they are now `FactStrip variant="bar"` — white on blue, the caption above each figure, a rule between the cells, "Crore" set a size down beside its number, and "View Dashboard" in a cell of its own with `tone="inverse"` because the ground under it is brand. On a phone the cells stack with a horizontal rule between them and the action falls to the foot.
